description: This file provides database utility functions for connecting to a MySQL database, executing queries, and performing CRUD operations on a 'notes' table, including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting notes.

methods.name: int _env_int(name: str, default: int)
methods.description: Parses an environment variable as an integer, returning a default if not set or invalid.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _parse_mysql_url(mysql_url: str)
methods.description: Parses a MySQL URL into its components like host, port, user, password, and database name.

methods.name: Connection get_connection()
methods.description: Creates and returns a new pymysql database connection, configured with environment variables or defaults.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Dict[str,Any]],int,Optional[int]] _execute_one( query: str, params: Optional[Tuple[Any, ...]] = None )
methods.description: Executes a single SQL query and returns the result rows, affected row count, and last insert ID.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_all_notes()
methods.description: Fetches all notes ordered by most recent update or creation.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_note_by_id(note_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a single note by ID or returns None if not found.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_note(title: str, content: str)
methods.description: Creates a new note with given title and content, then returns the created record.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update_note(note_id: int, title: Optional[str], content: Optional[str])
methods.description: Partially updates a note by ID with new title and/or content; returns the updated record or None if not found.

methods.name: bool delete_note(note_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID; returns True if successful, False if not found.

ctags.name: create_note
ctags.pattern: /^def create_note(title: str, content: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.pattern: /^def update_note(note_id: int, title: Optional[str], content: Optional[str]) -> Optional[Dict[str/
